answers.rationale: When not in an explicit transaction, each INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE appends a WAL Commit record immediately after execution, giving autocommit semantics.

presented_options.A: ARIES-style WAL with explicit undo and redo records plus a separate dirty-page table checkpoint

answers.rationale: The WAL is append-only; on startup read_all_records replays all records, and txn_mgr.replay_wal rebuilds commit/abort state so uncommitted suffix is discarded.

presented_options.D: no per-record check; a single CRC covers the whole WAL file on clean shutdown

answers.rationale: Each WAL record stores a CRC32 after its data; read_record_from returns a CRC mismatch error on the first bad record, halting replay.
